definitions.explanation: A dark area produced by blocking light.
The outline of a person or thing.
An image seen in water or a mirror.

examples.english: The shadow of the tree is cast on the ground.

examples.japanese: ⟦{夕方|ゆうがた}→夕方：01010_yuugata⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、{影|かげ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{長|なが}く→長い：00491_nagai⟧⟦{伸|の}びる→伸びる：01974_nobiru⟧。
examples.english: In the evening, shadows grow long.

examples.japanese: ⟦{人影|ひとかげ}→人影：16212_hitokage⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{見|み}えた→見える：01165_mieru⟧。

examples.english: There's no sign of him at all.
I could see someone's figure moving at the far end of the dark road.
A reflection appears on the water.

examples.japanese: ⟦{湖|みずうみ}→湖：00867_mizuumi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{山|やま}→山：02168_yama⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{影|かげ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{映|うつ}っていた→映る：12964_utsuru⟧。
examples.english: The reflection of the mountain was visible on the lake.

examples.japanese: ⟦{風|かぜ}→風：00641_kaze⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦やんで→止む：01153_yamu⟧⟦{水面|すいめん}→水面：04307_suimen⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{静|しず}かになる→静か：00755_shizuka⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、⟦{木々|きぎ}→木々：04811_kigi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{影|かげ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦くっきりと→くっきり：19407_kukkiri⟧⟦{映|うつ}った→映る：12964_utsuru⟧。
examples.english: When the wind died down and the water became still, the reflections of the trees appeared clearly.

notes:
{影|かげ} has three related meanings: the dark area cast by an object blocking light, the visible outline or figure of a person, and a reflection in water or a mirror.

{影|かげ} VS ⟦{陰|かげ}→陰：14593_kage⟧:
Both are read かげ but differ in nuance:
- {影|かげ}: the shadow itself (dark shape), a silhouette, or reflection
- ⟦{陰|かげ}→陰：14593_kage⟧: shaded area, behind the scenes, hidden side

- {影|かげ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{潜|ひそ}める→潜める：noentry⟧: to hide, to lie low
- {影|かげ}⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{形|かたち}→形：02193_katachi⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧: completely gone, vanished without a trace
